items.stem: Which TWO statements about React Query are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Query keys identify and cache a query
options.rationale: Correct: the key is how the cache stores and finds data.

options.text: Invalidating a query triggers a refetch
options.rationale: Correct: invalidation marks data stale and refetches.

options.text: Mutations can never affect the cache
options.rationale: Mutations commonly update or invalidate the cache.

options.text: Query keys should change on every render

items.explanation: Correct: the key is how the cache stores and finds data.
